properties.text: THE BEAM BALANCE -- a weighing you do yourself.  Every 30 seconds the AutoRandom puts a new sample on the pan, somewhere between 5 and 500 g, and the plate never tells you what it weighs.  You are the controller this time.  Spin the wheel over the two knobs to slide the riders along the beams: RIDER A is the heavy one, 0..480 g in notches of 20; RIDER B is the light one, 0..24 g in single grams.  The beam tips towards whichever side is heavier -- a gram moves it visibly, twenty grams put it on its stop -- and the readout tells you which way to go.  Bring the pointer onto the green zero mark and the riders ARE the sample: only then does the plate say how much it weighs.  Then the next one lands.  Coarse first, then fine: find the notch on A where the beam flips, back off one, and finish with B.

properties.output: A new sample on the pan.

properties.program:
# THE BEAM BALANCE -- a weighing you do yourself
#
# Every 30 seconds a new sample lands on the pan: `sample`, from the
# AutoRandom, somewhere between 5 and 500 g.  The plate never prints it.
# You slide the two riders with the knobs -- A, the heavy one, 0..480 g
# in notches of 20; B, the light one, 0..24 g in single grams -- and the
# beam tips towards whichever side is heavier.  When the pointer sits on
# the zero mark the riders ARE the sample, and only then does the plate
# say so.

m  = round(sample)
Ar = round(A / 20) * 20
Br = round(B)
net = m - Ar - Br

# the beam tips a little per gram and then rests on its stops
th = radians(8 * tanh(net / 3))
c  = cos(th)
s  = sin(th)
ok = abs(net) < 0.5
has = m > 0

view -66, -49.5, 66, 49.5
align "centre", "middle"

# --- where the beam turns ---------------------------------------------------
px = -30
py = 12

# --- the base and the pillar ------------------------------------------------
color "#202020"
width 0.5
fill "#d8d4cc"
rect -62, -14, 124, 4
nofill
fill "#9c9a94"
poly px - 3, -10, px + 3, -10, px + 1.2, py - 1, px - 1.2, py - 1
poly px, py, px - 2, py - 3, px + 2, py - 3
nofill

# the post at the far end, with the zero mark the pointer must find
px2 = 62
width 0.5
line px2, -10, px2, py + 10
width 0.3
repeat 9
  line px2 - 1.5 - (i == 4), py - 1.5 + 2 * (i - 4), px2, py - 1.5 + 2 * (i - 4)
end
color "#2e8b57"
width 0.6
line px2 - 3, py - 1.5, px2, py - 1.5

# --- the beams: two bars, turned with the beam --------------------------------
# a point (u, v) in the beam's own frame is (px + u c - v s, py + u s + v c)
color "#202020"
width 0.4
fill "#c9b27c"
poly px - 24 * c, py - 24 * s,
     px + 86 * c, py + 86 * s,
     px + 86 * c - 3 * s, py + 86 * s + 3 * c,
     px - 24 * c - 3 * s, py - 24 * s + 3 * c
poly px + 4 * c + 4 * s, py + 4 * s - 4 * c,
     px + 86 * c + 4 * s, py + 86 * s - 4 * c,
     px + 86 * c + 7 * s, py + 86 * s - 7 * c,
     px + 4 * c + 7 * s, py + 4 * s - 7 * c
nofill
# the pointer, off the end of the beam
width 0.5
line px + 86 * c + 1.5 * s, py + 86 * s - 1.5 * c,
     px + 91 * c + 1.5 * s, py + 91 * s - 1.5 * c

# notches: beam A every 20 g (3 units), beam B every gram (3 units)
width 0.25
repeat 25
  line px + (8 + 3 * i) * c - 3 * s, py + (8 + 3 * i) * s + 3 * c,
       px + (8 + 3 * i) * c - (3 - 1 - (i % 5 == 0)) * s,
       py + (8 + 3 * i) * s + (3 - 1 - (i % 5 == 0)) * c
end
repeat 25
  line px + (8 + 3 * i) * c + 4 * s, py + (8 + 3 * i) * s - 4 * c,
       px + (8 + 3 * i) * c + (4 + 1 + (i % 5 == 0)) * s,
       py + (8 + 3 * i) * s - (4 + 1 + (i % 5 == 0)) * c
end
font 2.6
color "#606060"
repeat 5
  text px + (8 + 15 * i) * c - 6 * s, py + (8 + 15 * i) * s + 6 * c, "%.0f", 100 * i
end
repeat 5
  text px + (8 + 15 * i) * c + 10 * s, py + (8 + 15 * i) * s - 10 * c, "%.0f", 5 * i
end

# --- the riders -------------------------------------------------------------
ua = 8 + 3 * Ar / 20
ub = 8 + 3 * Br
color "#202020"
width 0.35
fill "#3a5a9b"
poly px + (ua - 1.4) * c - 3 * s, py + (ua - 1.4) * s + 3 * c,
     px + (ua + 1.4) * c - 3 * s, py + (ua + 1.4) * s + 3 * c,
     px + (ua + 1.4) * c - 5.5 * s, py + (ua + 1.4) * s + 5.5 * c,
     px + (ua - 1.4) * c - 5.5 * s, py + (ua - 1.4) * s + 5.5 * c
fill "#8a5a2b"
poly px + (ub - 1) * c + 4 * s, py + (ub - 1) * s - 4 * c,
     px + (ub + 1) * c + 4 * s, py + (ub + 1) * s - 4 * c,
     px + (ub + 1) * c + 2 * s, py + (ub + 1) * s - 2 * c,
     px + (ub - 1) * c + 2 * s, py + (ub - 1) * s - 2 * c
nofill

# --- the pan, which stays level while its stem rides the beam ----------------
xs = px - 20 * c
ys = py - 20 * s
color "#202020"
width 0.5
line xs, ys + 3, xs, ys + 12
fill "#b8b8b0"
rect xs - 12, ys + 12, 24, 1.2
nofill

# the sample: a block as big as its mass, anonymous until you find it
k = 3 * cbrt(m / 10) / has
fill "#5b4a3a"
rect xs - k / 2, ys + 13.2, k, k
nofill
color "#f4efe6"
font 3.4
text xs / (has * (ok == 0)), ys + 13.2 + k / 2, "?"

# ========================================================================
#  THE READOUT
# ========================================================================
color "#202020"
font 4.2
align "left", "top"
text -62, -18, "riders  %.0f g + %.0f g = %.0f g", Ar, Br, Ar + Br
color "#b03a2e"
text -62 / (has * (net > 0.5)), -24, "the pan is heavier -- add weight"
text -62 / (has * (net < -0.5)), -24, "the riders are heavier -- take some off"
color "#2e8b57"
font 5
text -62 / (has * ok), -24, "balanced: the sample is %.0f g", m
color "#202020"
font 5
align "right", "top"
text 64, 47, "The beam balance"
color "#606060"
font 3.6
text 64, 41, "a new sample every 30 s"
text 64 / (has == 0), 36.5, "waiting for the first one..."
